lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\QOwnNotesAPI\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

3 uses of the private API of the server in 1 file. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

vimeo/psalm, friendsofphp/php-cs-fixer, phpunit/phpunit are in require-dev of composer.json. The manual recommends a vendor-bin/ of bamarni/composer-bin-plugin per tool, so that the dependencies of a tool cannot conflict with those of the app.

lines: 1 use in 1 file of the public API that is deprecated in Nextcloud 32 to 35. The text of the tag names the replacement where it has one.
lib/Controller/NoteApiController.php:245 OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ: deprecated since Nextcloud 13; Use \OCP\Constants::PERMISSION_READ instead

The app reads and writes its app config in 1 place and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.

Nothing in the app calls 4 routes outside OCS whose method allows requests from other origins (CORS), or that answer the preflight of such a request (OPTIONS). They are there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
